_readme: Judged queries against tests/eval/corpus.json. `relevant` lists corpus keys a
reader would call a hit; an empty list is a query that must return NOTHING, and
those are as load-bearing as the positive ones — a retriever that answers every
question with something is a retriever nobody can trust.
Questions are written the way people actually ask them: whole sentences, mixed
Polish and English, inflected nouns, punctuation. The bug this suite exists to
prevent was invisible precisely because the old tests searched with keywords
that all appeared in one lesson.
`requiresSemantic: true` marks a query lexical retrieval provably cannot answer:
the question and the lesson share meaning but no words — usually because one is
in English and the other in Polish. They are scored separately rather than
quietly dropped, so the cost of running without embeddings is a number in the
report instead of an opinion in a README.

queries.query: wp eval koszty zamówień backfill lipiec
queries.why: The reported failure. No single lesson holds every term; implicit AND returned nothing.

queries.query: dlaczego mój skrypt bashowy kończy się kodem 141 bez żadnego komunikatu?
queries.why: Punctuation and a full sentence; also a global lesson filed under another project.

queries.query: zniknęła mi niezacommitowana poprawka po teście mutacyjnym
deploy padł przy pushu do chronionej gałęzi
why does recall return nothing when the lessons clearly exist?
queries.why: English question, Polish lesson, no shared vocabulary at all. Only embeddings can bridge this — it is the measured case for turning them on.

queries.query: NODE_MODULE_VERSION mismatch przy starcie serwera MCP
queries.why: native-module-abi is found lexically; npm-rebuild-vs-install shares meaning but almost no words with the question.

queries.query: czy koszt dostawcy jest netto czy brutto?
jak liczona jest marża w module finanse i skąd bierze się różnica
queries.why: The long lesson: 3k+ characters, which bm25 length normalisation penalises.

queries.query: faktura nie powinna się generować dla zamówień za pobraniem
zamówienie zostało w pending mimo że blik przeszedł
dwie wtyczki nadpisują się w kasie
czy muszę restartować sesję po zmianie konfiguracji mcp?
licznik wyświetleń pokazuje zero dla wszystkich starszych wierszy
zmieniłem model embeddingów i wyszukiwanie przestało cokolwiek zwracać
stary html wisi po wdrożeniu mimo poprawnego kodu
hreflang między wersją polską a angielską nie działa
co wiemy o kosztach zamówieniach w sklepie
queries.why: Inflected: the lesson says 'Koszty zamówień', the question says 'kosztach zamówieniach'. Only the prefix retriever bridges this.

queries.query: pułapka z pipefail przy potoku
queries.why: Filtered to kamar, but the lesson is filed under claude-code-setup with scope=global. It must cross the project filter — that is what scope is for.

queries.query: równoległe zapisy do sqlite z kilku procesów
kubernetes istio service mesh sidecar injection
queries.why: Nothing in the base is about this. Returning something here would be worse than silence.

queries.query: roadmap obliczeń kwantowych na przyszły kwartał
queries.why: Polish negative — the stemmer is aggressive, so this checks it does not manufacture matches.

queries.query: please update the meeting notes with the client's phone number
queries.why: Common vocabulary — update, notes, client — and a topic the base genuinely has nothing on. The first version of this query said 'the service keeps failing after every update', which the vector arm answered with the service-worker lesson. That was MY error, not the retriever's: semantically the two really are close. A negative has to be unrelated in meaning as well as unanswered, or it measures nothing.

queries.query: how do we handle expenses for the team lunch
queries.why: Same correction. 'errors in test data' has a semantic neighbour in a base full of lessons about errors and tests; expenses for lunch does not.

queries.query: why does the cached response show old records after a deploy
queries.why: English question, Polish lesson, and the shared vocabulary is thin — cache and deploy only.

queries.query: a mass update locks the orders table
queries.why: English question against a Polish lesson; 'update' alone is common enough to mislead the lexical arm.

queries.query: alert powinien mówić o skutku dla użytkownika a nie o metryce
service worker zostaje na starej wersji dopóki nie zamknę kart
data pokazuje się przesunięta o dzień dla użytkownika z innej strefy
gdzie trzymać dane testowe żeby test opisywał ten sam przypadek
jak klient odróżnia błąd transportu od błędu domeny
stary html po wdrożeniu i stare rekordy z cache
queries.why: Spans two lessons that each answer half — the shape the coverage floor is most likely to silence.
